text.name: Shadow Fleet
text.rules: Draw from SAE's Contingency deck. If the result is 3 or more, record "sanctions evaded", then SAE spends 2 points on one action; otherwise, record "tanker seized", then LIO spends 1 point on actions.
text.history: From 2022 a growing fleet of ageing, obscurely owned tankers carried Russian oil outside Western insurance and price-cap rules.
